pages.text: Electrolysing water leaves the heavy molecules behind: a thousand millibuckets of $(fluid)Water$() give ten of $(fluid)Heavy Water$(), and electrolysing that gives $(fluid)Deuterium$(). $(item)Lithium$() is won from Deep Brine; the Gas Centrifuge Cascade enriches it to $(item)Lithium-6$().

In the $(item)Irradiation Chamber$() - a neutron source in one slot, never used up - lithium-6 catches a neutron and splits into helium and $(fluid)Tritium$(). Uranium-235 fissions into $(item)Technetium-99m$() and a spent fuel rod; plutonium fed neutrons for long enough climbs to $(item)Californium-252$(), and californium's flux turns uranium-238 into plutonium-239.

The $(item)Decontamination Scrubber$() melts fission products and spent salt into $(item)Nuclear Waste Glass$(), and takes the uranium back out of spent fuel rods. Radium decays, in the Decay Chamber, to $(item)Polonium-210$(); monazite sand gives $(item)Thorium-232$().
